citazioni: Differential scanning calorimetry (DSC) analysis reflects that 4I-CASS experiences a solid-to-solid structural phase transition at around 342 K (Fig. 3a), while 4I-CACS and 4I-CAHCS do not have structural phase transition behaviors.

Above the structural phase transition temperature of 342 K for 4I-CASS, its crystal symmetry changes from P21 in phase I (the phase below the solid-to-solid phase transition temperature of 342 K) to C2 in phase II (the phase above the solid-to-solid phase transition temperature of 342 K while below the solid-liquid crystal phase transition temperature of 444 K), both of which have a similar packing structure, except for the doubling of the unit cell because of the presence of the two-fold rotation axes in phase II (Fig. 2c, e and Supplementary Fig. 5).

Correspondingly, the real part (ε’) of the dielectric permittivity shows remarkable step-like anomaly near 342 K for 4I-CASS and λ-like anomalies at around 444, 442, and 423 K for 4I-CASS, 4I-CACS, and 4I-CAHCS (Supplementary Figs. 10–12), respectively.

From Fig. 3b, with the increase in temperature, the PXRD pattern at 423 K shows some changes accompanied by the shift and splitting of several peaks compared to that at 300 K, corresponding to the transition of phase I to phase II.
It should be pointed out that the structural phase transition from phase I to phase II is completely reversible in the temperature range below the transition temperature of 444 K.

In phase II, the thermal motions of some carbon atoms in the 4I-CASS molecular tails are intensified to become disordered to a certain extent, so each of them is split to be modeled as two equivalent positions (Fig. 2b).
eventi.note: P21 -> C2 con cella raddoppiata e disordine delle code; 342 K dal DSC (anomalia dielettrica «near 342 K»). Nel VT-PXRD il diffrattogramma a 423 K, gia' in fase II, differisce da quello a 300 K: non e' la T di transizione. Reversibile («completely reversible in the temperature range below ... 444 K») senza condizioni per il ritorno.

citazioni: From DSC curves, all of 4I-CASS, 4I-CACS, and 4I-CAHCS experience a phase transition from solid crystal phase to liquid crystal phase with a transition temperature of 444, 442, and 423 K, respectively (Fig. 3a and Supplementary Fig. 10,11).
As the temperature rose to above 444 K, the sample of 4I-CASS softened and entered the LC state, by the observation under perpendicular polarized light (Fig. 3c).
When the temperature increased to 463 K, most of the diffraction peaks in the PXRD pattern disappeared, indicating entry into the cholesteric liquid crystal phase.
In the second heating run, the phase between 444 and 490 K is the cholesteric LC phase (Ch), and the phase beyond 490 K is liquid phase (LP).
eventi.note: Solido -> fase colesterica a 444 K (DSC; POM sopra 444 K; il PXRD a 463 K ha perso quasi tutti i picchi). Il PXRD a 463 K e la POM a 453 K sono T di osservazione nella fase LC.

citazioni: In addition, the clearing point and crystallization temperature point of 4I-CASS are 490 and 389 K, respectively.
Subsequently, the visual field became dark with the temperature continuing to rise to 500 K, which means that the LC phase disappeared and entered an isotropic liquid state.
In the second heating run, the phase between 444 and 490 K is the cholesteric LC phase (Ch), and the phase beyond 490 K is liquid phase (LP).
eventi.note: Punto di chiarificazione 490 K (DSC); in POM il campo diventa scuro a 500 K (Ch ancora a 453 e 483 K nella didascalia di Fig. 3c): compatibile.

citazioni: Particularly, the DSC curves show that 4I-CASS has two liquid crystal phases with a transition temperature of 431 K measured in the cooling run.
In the second cooling run, an emerging LC phase between 389 and 431 K is SmC* phase, and a crystalline phase (phase III) is generated below 389 K.
However, as the temperature decreased to 423 K, the texture morphology further changed with the appearance of a broken lined focal-conic texture, meaning the appearance of a SmC* phase.
In the subsequent cooling runs, a distinct diffraction peak of 5.5° appeared at 408 K, suggesting the formation of a LC phase with a molecular layer spacing of 16.04 Å.
The ratio of the interlayer spacing to the molecular length (25.88 Å) is less than 1, indicating that this liquid crystal LC phase is SmC* phase.
eventi.note: Colesterica -> SmC* in raffreddamento a 431 K (DSC). La POM la vede a 423 K (texture focal-conic a linee spezzate) e il PXRD a 408 K (picco a 5.5°): T di osservazione a gradini, non transizioni diverse. Fra due fasi liquido-cristalline, riportata per completezza del ciclo termico.
